at_utc_meaning: Observed with `date -u` just before this record was written; the commit time is in git and will be later.
difference: The declared time is 29 s AFTER the commit. Record 0008 repeated the defect it was correcting: its at_utc was an estimate, not an observed time, despite 0008's own stated practice change.
materiality: Immaterial: 0008 is a correction and disclosure record with no prediction. FY2026 category-329 was 0 at 22:10:04Z, the last check before it.
why_new_record_not_edit: Same reason as 0008: preserve the published bytes and hash (bc2b7349...).
practice: Each at_utc from here on is the output of `date -u` taken before the record is written, and is checked to be no later than the commit time before pushing.
